name: Item Price Calculation With VAT Rat
script:
# -------------------------------------------------- # CONSTANTS / SETTINGS # -------------------------------------------------- DEBUG = True PRICE_LIST = "Standard Selling" # -------------------------------------------------- # MAIN PROCESS ON SUBMIT # -------------------------------------------------- if doc.docstatus == 1: for row in doc.items: # -------------------------------------------------- # 1️⃣ CHECK TOTAL STOCK (ONLY INCLUDED WAREHOUSES) # -------------------------------------------------- stock_qty = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT SUM(b.actual_qty) FROM `tabBin` b INNER JOIN `tabWarehouse` w ON w.name = b.warehouse WHERE b.item_code = %s AND w.custom_include_in_valuation = 1 """, row.item_code)[0][0] or 0 # ❗ CONDITION 1: IF NO STOCK → SKIP if stock_qty <= 0: if DEBUG: frappe.msgprint( f"{row.item_code}: No positive stock in valuation warehouses. Skipped.", title="Markup Skipped" ) continue # -------------------------------------------------- # 2️⃣ FETCH ITEM MASTER # -------------------------------------------------- item = frappe.get_doc("Item", row.item_code) classification = (item.custom_item_classification or "").strip() group = (item.item_group or "").strip() category = (item.custom_item_category or "").strip() performance = (item.custom_product_performance or "").strip() # -------------------------------------------------- # 3️⃣ FETCH MARKUPS # -------------------------------------------------- A = float(frappe.db.get_value("Item Classification", classification, "base_markup") or 0) / 100 if classification else 0 B = float(frappe.db.get_value("Item Group", group, "custom_base_markup") or 0) / 100 if group else 0 C = float(frappe.db.get_value("Item Category", category, "base_markup") or 100) / 100 if category else 1 D = float(frappe.db.get_value("Product Performance", performance, "base_markup") or 100) / 100 if performance else 1 final_markup = (A + B) * C * D # -------------------------------------------------- # 4️⃣ GET TRUE WAREHOUSE VALUATION (LATEST IN RATE) # -------------------------------------------------- warehouse_list = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT b.warehouse, b.actual_qty FROM `tabBin` b INNER JOIN `tabWarehouse` w ON w.name = b.warehouse WHERE b.item_code = %s AND b.actual_qty > 0 AND w.custom_include_in_valuation = 1 """, row.item_code, as_dict=True) if not warehouse_list: continue warehouse_rates = [] for wh in warehouse_list: latest_rate = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT sle.incoming_rate FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle WHERE sle.item_code = %s AND sle.warehouse = %s AND sle.actual_qty > 0 AND sle.is_cancelled = 0 AND sle.docstatus = 1 ORDER BY sle.posting_date DESC, sle.posting_time DESC, sle.creation DESC LIMIT 1 """, (row.item_code, wh.warehouse)) if latest_rate and latest_rate[0][0]: warehouse_rates.append(float(latest_rate[0][0])) if not warehouse_rates: continue # 👉 If one warehouse → take that rate if len(warehouse_rates) == 1: valuation = warehouse_rates[0] else: # 👉 If multiple → take highest rate valuation = max(warehouse_rates) # -------------------------------------------------- # 5️⃣ APPLY MARKUP + VAT # -------------------------------------------------- new_price = valuation * (1 + final_markup) vat_rate = float(frappe.db.get_value("Item Category", category, "vat_rate") or 0) / 100 if category else 0 if vat_rate > 0: new_price *= (1 + vat_rate) new_price = round(new_price, 2) # -------------------------------------------------- # 6️⃣ FETCH PREVIOUS SELLING PRICE # -------------------------------------------------- previous_selling_rate = frappe.db.get_value( "Item Price", {"item_code": row.item_code, "price_list": PRICE_LIST}, "price_list_rate" ) or 0 row.custom_previous_item_rate = previous_selling_rate # -------------------------------------------------- # 7️⃣ UPDATE OR CREATE ITEM PRICE # -------------------------------------------------- existing = frappe.get_all( "Item Price", filters={"item_code": row.item_code, "price_list": PRICE_LIST}, fields=["name"] ) if existing: ip = frappe.get_doc("Item Price", existing[0].name) ip.price_list_rate = new_price ip.reference = doc.name ip.flags.ignore_permissions = True ip.save() else: ip = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "Item Price", "price_list": PRICE_LIST, "item_code": row.item_code, "price_list_rate": new_price, "uom": item.stock_uom, "reference": doc.name }) ip.flags.ignore_permissions = True ip.insert() # -------------------------------------------------- # 8️⃣ DEBUG OUTPUT # -------------------------------------------------- if DEBUG: total_markup_percent = (new_price / valuation - 1) * 100 frappe.msgprint(f""" {row.item_code}

Previous Selling Price: {previous_selling_rate}
Valuation Used: {valuation}

Classification (A): {A*100:.2f}%
Group (B): {B*100:.2f}%
Category Multiplier (C): {C}
Performance Multiplier (D): {D}

Final Markup %: {(final_markup*100):.2f}%
VAT %: {(vat_rate*100):.2f}%

New Selling Price: {new_price}
Total Increase from Valuation: {total_markup_percent:.2f}%
Reference Linked: {doc.name} """, title="Markup Calculation Summary")

name: Item Price List After Cancell
script:
# Revert Item Price when Purchase Invoice is cancelled

if doc.docstatus == 2:      # CANCELLED

    for row in doc.items:

        item_code = row.item_code
        previous_rate = row.custom_previous_item_rate   # custom field

        if not previous_rate:
            continue

        # Fetch Item Price in Standard Selling
        ip = frappe.get_all(
            "Item Price",
            filters={
                "item_code": item_code,
                "price_list": "Standard Selling"
            },
            fields=["name"],
            limit=1
        )

        if not ip:
            continue

        ip_name = ip[0].name

        # Restore Selling Price
        frappe.db.set_value("Item Price", ip_name, "price_list_rate", previous_rate)
        frappe.db.set_value("Item Price", ip_name, "reference", "")
